test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the percentage profit after selling an article at a certain price, if there is a loss of 12{ {1} over 2}% when the article is sold at half of the that selling price?
solution:
**Given:**

Loss of 12¹⁄₂% when article is sold at half the selling price. Find the percentage profit at the full selling price.

**Formula used:**

If selling price (SP) is half, then cost price (CP) is calculated as:

CP = frac{(SP { at half)}}{1 - Loss%}

Then, Profit% = ((SP - CP) / CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

Let full SP = 2x, so half SP = x

Loss% = 12.5%

⇒ CP = x / (1 - 12.5 / 100)

⇒ CP = x / (0.875)

⇒ CP = 8x / 7

Profit% = ((2x - 8x / 7) / (8x / 7)) × 100

⇒ Profit% = ((14x - 8x) / 8x) × 100

⇒ Profit% = (6x / 8x) × 100

⇒ Profit% = 75%

**∴ The correct answer is option (1) 75%.**
